source_corpus.name: OpenAssistant/oasst1
source_corpus.version: 2023-04-12 OpenAssistant Conversations Dataset (OASST1), Hugging Face dataset card revision fetched 2026-08-17
source_corpus.use_in_this_experiment: Few-shot style anchors for novice/non-expert instruction phrasing only; not used as task content.

selection.selector: deterministic manual selection from English prompter messages after filtering for review_result=true, deleted=false, non-sensitive, short general-help prompts
notes: No Johnny / CC BY-NC material used.
Examples are intentionally domain-general and only anchor casual novice wording.

Can you tell me more?  What would you recommend as a basic set of equipment to get started with?  How much will it cost?
my brother looked over my shoulder and saw this conversation. could you explain this conversation to someone with no prior knowledge of the subject
